about: Print presets Nozzle It All makes where the vendor ships none (scripts/bundle_printer_library.py --derived). Each is the vendor's own base preset with only the listed settings changed; see docs/upstream/PROVENANCE.md.
recipe_source: Snapmaker Orca cbf7bbb, resources/profiles/Snapmaker/process/0.10mm Color Mixing @Snapmaker U1 (0.4 nozzle).json

left_out.ooze_prevention, standby_temperature_del: idle-toolhead cooling on the U1's four toolheads; CANVAS feeds one nozzle
left_out.prime_volume, wipe_tower_filament, prime: the U1's per-toolhead priming tower; CANVAS changes purge by Elegoo's own flush volumes and tower
left_out.initial_layer_print_height: Elegoo's 0.2 mm first layer kept for bed adhesion; the first layer has no blends to smooth
left_out.enable_arc_fitting, precise_outer_wall,: U1 tuning not tied to color mixing; Elegoo's values kept

presets.name: 0.10mm Color Mixing @Elegoo CC 0.4 nozzle
presets.description: Made by Nozzle It All for Full Spectrum and ColorMix blends on CANVAS: Elegoo's 0.12mm Fine profile with Snapmaker's U1 Color Mixing changes (0.10 mm layers for smoother color transitions, slow outer walls). Every color change is a CANVAS filament change with a purge, so blended prints take much longer and use more filament. Not yet tested on a real printer.
